description: Optimization is central to modern machine learning and artificial intelligence. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the mathematical and theoretical foundations of optimization. Students will learn to formulate and analyse machine learning and optimization problems, such as regression, neural networks, and linear and quadratic programs. The Support Vector Machines problem will be discussed as a well-known example of convex optimization with inequality constraints. Students will explore a variety of gradient-based optimization techniques, including gradient descent, stochastic gradient descent, and more. The course provides the essential background for advanced study and research in machine learning and artificial intelligence.
